meta.name: exploratory-test
meta.description: Execute multi-level exploratory testing of the app covering basic functionality, complex operations, adversarial testing, and cross-cutting scenarios, plus usability observations through a UX lens reported separately from defects. Deeper than /smoke-test. Use when the user asks to "exploratory test", "test thoroughly", "test all scenarios", "deep test", "test edge cases", "test everything", "break it", "find bugs by testing", "test usability", or "check the UX while testing".

copy.tagline: 对应用进行多层级探索性测试，发现功能、边界和可用性问题。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要深入测试应用的各种场景和边界情况。
